s.how: Brown 125g butter and cool. Beat with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 225g flour. Wrap dough around 12 small chocolate eggs, shape into ovals and bake at 175C for 12 minutes. Flick with cocoa mixed with a little water for speckles.

s.note: clever girl, in the long grass
s.how: Cut 6 flour tortillas into curved claw shapes. Brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and smoked paprika and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp. Mash 3 avocados with the juice of 2 limes and salt for guacamole.

m.note: the lunch where Grant, Sattler and Malcolm argue with Hammond
m.how: Brush 2 lamb racks with Dijon and press on chopped parsley and breadcrumbs. Roast at 220C until 55C inside, about 20 minutes, and rest. Boil 300g peas with mint and blitz with butter. Roast 800g baby potatoes. Slice and plate neatly.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Leave 1L vanilla ice cream out for 10 minutes so it softens a little too much. Scoop three each into chilled coupes, pour over the fudge and scatter crushed honeycomb.

d.how: Fill four tall glasses with ice and lemon slices and top with chilled sparkling water. Set them on the table where everyone can see them, and keep an eye on the surface for ripples.
